title: HolePatternInput
description: Params contract for FLANGE's user-defined hole-pattern branch. Mirrors Models/HolePatternInput.cs field-for-field — regenerate this file whenever that record changes.

Offset.description: Draw the first hole offset by half the angular spacing instead of at angle 0. Mirrors the "offset" dialog tile ("1" = offset, "0" = on-centre).

FlangeTangentAngleDegrees.description: Flange tilt angle in degrees. 0 draws the flat pattern (circles); non-zero draws the angled/tilted pattern (ellipses). Mirrors the "ftang" dialog tile.

PatternDiameter.description: Pitch circle diameter the holes sit on. Mirrors the "ddpcd" input_pattern dialog tile.

NumberOfHoles.description: Number of holes in the pattern. Mirrors the "num" input_pattern dialog tile.

HoleDiameter.description: Diameter of each hole. Mirrors the "holedia" input_pattern dialog tile.

CenterX.description: X of the pattern centre point. Mirrors the original interactive "Pick centre of pcd." getpoint.

CenterY.description: Y of the pattern centre point. Mirrors the original interactive "Pick centre of pcd." getpoint.

RotationAngleDegrees.description: Rotation applied to the finished pattern about the centre point, in degrees. Replaces the original angled-branch "ROTATE (catch) pick_pcd pause" — pause is live drag input with no DA equivalent, so a fixed angle takes its place. 0 = no rotation.
